{{CSGO}}: 2016-01-18 }} '''Astralis''' is a [[:Category:Denmark|Danish]] professional esports organization founded in January 2016. Astralis are one of the most successful organizations in the history of ''Counter-Strike'' with 4 [[Majors]] and a record 406 consecutive days at #1 on [[HLTV]]'s team ranking from April 2018 to June 2019. It was partially owned by players of the former Danish [[Team SoloMid]]/[[? (Danish team)|Team Questionmark]] lineup. The rights to the '''Astralis''' name were obtained from the original founders of the [[astralis (Finnish team)|Finnish ''Counter-Strike'' team]]. {{cite web|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190926211128/http://astralis.gg/tqm-becomes-astralis|date=2016-01-18|archiveurl=http://archive.is/uc4uB|archivedate=2020-01-27|title=Team Questionmark becomes Astralis|publisher='''Astralis'''}} ==History== {{See also|Astralis/History|l1=History of Astralis}} ===Timeline=== {{Tabs dynamic |name1=2016 |name2=2017 |name3=2018 |name4=2019 |name5=2020 |name6=2021 |name7=2022 |name8=2023 |name9=2024 |name10=2025 |name11=2026 |This=11 |content1= *January 18th - [[?
